newsitem.title: USA: Vitech to set up $50 mln debt facility.
newsitem.headline: Vitech to set up $50 mln debt facility.

text.p: Vitech America Inc said on Wednesday it engaged Wasserstein Perella Emerging Markets LP to arrange and manage a receivables-based debt facility for up to $50 million.
The facility is tied to receivables due to Bahiatech Bahia Tecnologia Ltda, Vitech's Brazilian subsidiary.
Vitech is a direct marketer of computers, servers and networking equipment in Brazil.
Vitech shares were down 1/4 to 12-7/8 in mid-morning trading.
